title: Lucario brought both fists: the week in cards
intro: One free email every Sunday with the week in cards. Here's the latest issue as a magazine: tap the cover to open it, and sign up free at the bottom of the page.
opening: Zia and Luna here with your Sunday shuffle. Lucario showed up with both fists and a Z, Lorcana is moving into your phone, and Magic handed Commander players a whole desert of new Dune legends.
image_alt: Zia reports: Pokémon TCG's Flowing Fists revealed for Feb 6, 2027
pull: Lucario brought both fists and a Z.

stories.title: Pokémon TCG's Flowing Fists revealed for Feb 6, 2027
stories.summary: The Pokémon Company's Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists releases February 6, 2027 with over 110 cards, led by Mega Lucario Z ex and Mega Garchomp Z ex.
stories.quip: Lucario brought both fists and a Z.

facts: Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists releases February 6, 2027, as part of the Mega Evolution Series.
The expansion includes over 110 cards, with artwork inspired by the excitement of a tournament atmosphere.
Mega Lucario Z ex leads the set, with Mega Absol Z ex, Mega Garchomp Z ex and Mega Glimmora ex also featured.
ICv2 counts 15 Pokémon and Trainer cards with special illustrations.
It comes in Elite Trainer Boxes, Build & Battle boxes, 3-booster blisters, booster displays and hanger packs (ICv2).
details.why: It's the next English Pokémon TCG expansion, with a new group of Mega Pokémon ex for players and collectors to chase.

stories.title: Pokémon's Aura Seeker hits Japan Nov 27, all cards out
stories.summary: Japan's Aura Seeker expansion, starring Mega Lucario Z ex, releases November 27, 2026; all 78 main-set cards are revealed ahead of English Flowing Fists (Feb 6, 2027).

facts: The Pokémon Card Game MEGA expansion pack Aura Seeker (Hadou Seeker in Japanese) releases in Japan on Friday, November 27, 2026, with 5 cards per pack.
All 78 main-set cards are now revealed; it is Japan's seventh Mega Evolution set, starring Mega Lucario Z ex.
It is the first set with the Z Mega Evolutions from the Mega Dimension DLC: Mega Lucario Z ex, Mega Absol Z ex and Mega Garchomp Z ex, plus Mega Glimmora ex.
A special art rare of Crasher Wake's Fervor is drawn by manga artist Tetsuo Hara.
English players get the set's cards in Mega Evolution—Flowing Fists on February 6, 2027.
details.why: It's the first full look at the cards coming to the English Pokémon TCG in Flowing Fists early next year.

stories.title: Disney Lorcana is going digital: every card, crossplay
stories.summary: Ravensburger's first Disney Lorcana digital game dev blog (November 20, 2026) promises every card from every set, mobile and desktop crossplay and ranked play; no release date yet.
stories.quip: Finally, a deck you can shuffle on the bus.

facts: Ravensburger posted the first developer blog for the Disney Lorcana TCG digital game on November 20, 2026; the game was first announced at D23 in August 2026.
The goal is to include every card from every set released: characters, songs, actions and locations.
It follows the same rules with the same cards as the tabletop game, so decks built digitally can be brought to the table.
One account works on mobile and desktop with crossplay, plus ranked matchmaking and replayable practice matches for new players.
There is no release date yet; fans can sign up at the Disney Lorcana site to hear first when testing begins.
details.why: Lorcana players will be able to test decks and new cards any time, with skills that carry over to game night.

stories.title: Magic's Dune Secret Lair Superdrop lands November 30
stories.summary: Secret Lair x Dune, My Arrakis, My Superdrop, launches November 30, 2026 with eight new-to-Magic Dune legends and a new Shai-Hulud card.
stories.quip: Walk without rhythm to the checkout queue.

facts: My Arrakis, My Superdrop launches November 30, 2026, only on the Secret Lair store, with a pre-queue opening an hour before the 9 a.m. PT sale.
Secret Lair x Dune: Balance of Power has eight new-to-Magic legendary creatures, including Paul Atreides, Ducal Heir, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen and Princess Irulan Corrino.
Secret Lair x Dune: Deserts of Arrakis adds a new-to-Magic Shai-Hulud card, plus Crysknife, Thumper and Sandworm Incursion versions of existing cards.
Secret Lair x Dune: Spice is all halo foil, with Water of Life and Atreides and Harkonnen Spice Harvesters.
The new cards are legal in Commander, Legacy and Vintage; non-foil Balance of Power and Deserts of Arrakis come to WPN game stores at a later date.
details.why: It's Magic's biggest Dune crossover, adding brand-new legends that Commander players can build around.

stories.title: Magic's Nauctis drops Play Boosters for Booster Packs
stories.summary: Nauctis: The Sunken Realm (February 5, 2027) sells 14-card Booster Packs, 30 per box, instead of Play Boosters, and Collector Boosters drop from 15 cards to 12.
stories.quip: Fewer cards per Collector pack, more room in the binder.

facts: Nauctis: The Sunken Realm releases February 5, 2027 (MTG Arena February 2), with prereleases January 29 to February 4.
ICv2 reports Wizards has done away with Play Boosters for the set in favour of Booster Packs.
Each Booster Pack holds 14 cards plus a double-sided token, and a Booster Pack box holds 30 packs.
Collector Boosters now hold 12 cards instead of 15, with 12 Collector Boosters per box.
Both box types include a Sunken Treasures box topper, and about 1 in 1,000 Booster Packs and 1 in 300 Collector Boosters is a God Pack.
details.why: It changes what every Nauctis pack and box holds, for players drafting the set and collectors opening boxes.

stories.title: Stefan Schütz wins Magic World Championship 32
stories.summary: Stefan Schütz won Magic World Championship 32 in Atlanta on November 15, 2026 with Izzet Mission, taking the $100,000 first prize.
stories.quip: Mission accomplished. Literally, it was the deck name.

facts: Stefan Schütz won Magic World Championship 32 at MagicCon: Atlanta, which ran November 13-15, 2026.
He played Izzet Mission in Standard, a deck built around Anthropological Mission, a Star Trek card that joined Standard a week before the event.
First place pays $100,000, plus invitations to every 2027 Pro Tour and the 2027 Limited Championship.
Eduardo Sajgalik finished second ($50,000), with Kellen Pastore and James Drake rounding out the Top 4.
The World Champion also gets the chance to appear on an upcoming Magic card.
details.why: Worlds caps the 2026 season, and a card from a set released days earlier powered the winning deck.

stories.title: One Piece's OP-18 The Dominance of God lands Nov 20
stories.summary: One Piece Card Game's OP-18 The Dominance of God releases in English on November 20, 2026, with six new Leaders and a 4th Anniversary Event running to December 17.
stories.quip: Four years old and still asking for more Leaders. Franky approves.

facts: Booster Pack THE DOMINANCE OF GOD [OP-18] releases in English on November 20, 2026; its cards are tournament legal 7 days after release.
The set features Water Seven and the Holy Knights of God, with six new Leaders: Karoo, Monkey.D.Luffy, Ms. All Sunday, Franky, Saint Gunko and Spandam.
Saint Gunko and Saint Shamrock make their card game debut; the Super Alt Art card is Nico Robin and the Super Leader Alt Art is Saint Gunko.
One alt art card has original artwork by Yoshitaka Amano.

The 4th Anniversary Event (OP-18 Release Event) runs in stores November 20 to December 17, 2026: every player gets a P-161 Monkey.D.Luffy promo, and the winner gets a silver foil, gold stamped version.
details.why: It's the game's fourth anniversary set, with a long-awaited Franky Leader and a store event promo for everyone who plays.

stories.title: Star Wars: Unlimited's Icons 2027 Edition lands Nov 20
stories.summary: Star Wars: Unlimited's Icons 2027 Edition, a mini-set of over 190 cards, releases November 20, 2026, with a Darth Vader and Leia Organa Starter Box.
stories.quip: Vader or Leia? Pick a side before Friday, the box won't do it for you.

facts: Icons 2027 Edition releases November 20, 2026, the first Icons set for Star Wars: Unlimited.
It's a mini-set of over 190 cards focused on fan-favourite characters and straightforward mechanics.
Each booster pack has 9 cards: about 5 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 rare or legendary card and 1 Hyperspace foil.
The Starter Box has two pre-built 30-card decks led by Darth Vader and Leia Organa, plus deckbuilding packs and two Icons boosters.
The Booster 4-Pack adds an exclusive Cassian Andor variant card.
details.why: It's built as an easy way into the game, with two famous leaders in a ready-to-play box for two players.

stories.title: Riftbound's Convergence Fest hits Vegas Dec 11-13
stories.summary: Riftbound's Convergence Fest runs December 11-13, 2026 in Las Vegas, and participating US stores give out an exclusive Ionic Spark battlefield promo December 9-15.
stories.quip: Can't fly to Vegas? Your local store just became the after-party.

facts: Convergence Fest brings Riftbound and Teamfight Tactics to the Las Vegas Convention Center, December 11-13, 2026.
Side event tickets go on sale November 18 at 8 AM PT, for anyone with a Convergence Fest Attendee, TFT Competitor or Riftbound Competitor pass; prizes come from a shared Prize Wall.
From December 9 to 15, participating US local game stores hand out an exclusive Ionic Spark battlefield promo, while supplies last; it is also available to Convergence Fest attendees.
Each store decides how to give it out (demos, in-store events or watch parties), and Riot told stores not to use it as a purchase incentive.
The Encore after-party with DJ Sona follows on December 13 at Lot A outside AREA15.
details.why: It's Riftbound's big North American weekend, and the store promo lets players who can't travel to Vegas take part.

stories.title: Disney Lorcana returns to EPCOT with a Figment glimmer
stories.summary: Disney Lorcana returns to EPCOT International Festival of the Arts January 15 to March 1, 2027, with a festival-only Figment glimmer and Minnie, Belle and Alice promos.
stories.quip: Figment says one little spark is all it takes. And a Quest Booklet.

facts: Disney Lorcana returns to the EPCOT International Festival of the Arts at Walt Disney World, January 15 to March 1, 2027, its second year at the festival.
A free Quest Booklet from the Creations Shop starts the Collection Quest; trade with other guests for four cards to earn the Minnie Mouse, Musical Artist promo.

The Ink & Find Scavenger Hunt rewards the Belle, Reflective Writer promo, and a Hyperia City Illumineer's Trove bought in the park comes with Alice, Tea Alchemist (limit 2 per guest, while supplies last).
The six-card 2027 Festival Collection, sold only at the festival, includes a Figment glimmer plus Mickey Mouse, Little John, Powerline, Piglet and Tiana.
A premium foil Figment playmat, an art print and card artist signings on select days round out the festival.
details.why: It's a festival-only Figment card and three new Magical Places promos for Lorcana collectors visiting Walt Disney World early next year.

stories.title: Magic's Star Trek Commander Party runs Nov 20-26
stories.summary: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek Commander Party runs in WPN stores November 20-26, 2026 (again January 15-21, 2027), with Highly Illogical or Munitions Enthusiast promos.
stories.source: Magic: The Gathering (official); Wizards Play Network
stories.quip: Beam me up, but only after my commander resolves.

facts: Commander Party for Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek runs at WPN stores November 20-26, 2026, and again January 15-21, 2027.
It's a casual Commander event: on your turn you can tap a legendary creature to send an away team on a mission from the mission deck.
That creature becomes the mission specialist, and the mission's effects stay active until another player sends an away team; players without a legend can recruit an away team leader.
Each pod of three to four players gets a play aid, and stores receive mission cards and participation promos.
Players receive either a Munitions Enthusiast or Highly Illogical promo card (non-foil, traditional foil at WPN Premium stores), while supplies last.
details.why: It's a free-form, story-driven way to play the new Star Trek cards in Commander at your local store, with a promo for taking part.

stories.title: Magic's first God Packs arrive with Nauctis
stories.summary: Nauctis: The Sunken Realm (February 5, 2027) brings Magic's first God Packs: about 1 in 1,000 Booster Packs is all rares and mythics, plus ~500 Abyssal Lotus headliners.
stories.quip: One in a thousand. Start practicing your shocked face now.

facts: Nauctis: The Sunken Realm releases February 5, 2027 (MTG Arena February 2); prereleases run January 29 to February 4.
It's the first set with God Packs: every nonbasic card in a God Pack is a rare or mythic rare, with a God Pack celebration card inside.
About 1 in every 1,000 Booster Packs is a Booster God Pack, and about 1 in every 300 Collector Boosters is a Collector God Pack.
Collector Boosters can hold a textless raised foil Abyssal Lotus headliner; about 500 will be printed.
Each Booster Pack box and Collector Booster box includes a Sunken Treasures Box Topper with one pearlescent card.
details.why: God Packs turn any Nauctis pack into a possible jackpot, and they're coming to Magic's Multiverse sets from now on.

stories.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!'s HERO Force Structure Deck goes all-foil
stories.summary: Konami's 55-card all-foil Structure Deck of Jaden and Aster's HEROes arrives February 26, 2027, with two brand-new Ultra Rare cards and a bonus Secret Rare.
stories.quip: Every card a foil. Your sleeves are about to work overtime.

facts: Structure Deck: HERO Force (All-Foil Edition) is tournament legal February 26, 2027.
Official tournament stores get it from February 24, 2027.
It's a 55-card deck built on Jaden and Aster's HEROes, with every card in foil.
Two brand-new Ultra Rare cards are inside, plus a bonus Secret Rare that can upgrade to a Starlight Rare.
details.why: HERO players get a fully foiled, ready-built upgrade with brand-new support cards.
